author: StarTalk
description:
What’s up with rocket stages crashing into the moon? Neil deGrasse breaks down headlines about SpaceX rocket stages crashing into the moon and ways of dealing with space junk as we begin a possible permanent presence on the moon.

11:10 - Protecting the Moon Base
